metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM parser for Microsoft Defender for Office 365
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false, pack:bool=false) {
    EmailEvents
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend _unmapped = iff(pack, pack_all(), dynamic({}))
    | extend
        _action = tolower(DeliveryAction),
        _location = tolower(DeliveryLocation),
        _headersTo = column_ifexists("To", dynamic([])),
        _headersCc = column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([])),
        SrcIpAddr = case(
            SenderIPv4 !contains "/" and isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SenderIPv4)), SenderIPv4,
            SenderIPv6 !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SenderIPv6)), SenderIPv6,
            "")
    | extend
        _auth = parse_json(AuthenticationDetails),
        EmailDirection = case(EmailDirection =~ "Inbound", "Inbound",
            EmailDirection =~ "Outbound", "Outbound",
            EmailDirection =~ "Intra-org", "Internal", "Unknown"),
        EmailDeliveryLocation = case(_location == "inbox/folder", "Inbox",
            _location == "junk", "Junk", _location == "quarantine", "Quarantine",
            _location == "deleted items", "DeletedItems", ""),
        EventResult = case(_action == "blocked" or _location in ("failed", "dropped"), "Failure",
            _action in ("delivered", "junked", "replaced"), "Success", "NA")
    | project-rename
        EmailFromAddress = SenderFromAddress,
        EmailFromDomain = SenderFromDomain,
        EmailMailFromAddress = SenderMailFromAddress,
        EmailMailFromDomain = SenderMailFromDomain,
        Dst = RecipientEmailAddress,
        EmailSubject = Subject,
        DvcOriginalAction = DeliveryAction,
        EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation = DeliveryLocation,
        EventOriginalUid = ReportId,
        RuleName = EmailActionPolicy,
        ThreatOriginalCategory = ThreatTypes,
        ThreatName = ThreatNames,
        SrcUserId = SenderObjectId
    | extend
        EventVendor = "Microsoft",
        EventProduct = "Microsoft Defender for Office 365",
        Dvc = "Microsoft Defender for Office 365",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        EventSchema = "EmailEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventType = "EmailDelivery",
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
        EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
        EventMessage = case(isnull(TimeGenerated), "Missing source timestamp",
            isempty(Dst), "Missing source recipient", ""),
        DvcAction = case(_action == "blocked" and _location == "quarantine", "Quarantined",
            _action == "blocked", "Blocked", _action == "replaced", "Modified",
            _action in ("delivered", "junked"), "Delivered", "NA"),
        EventResultDetails = case(ThreatOriginalCategory has "Malware", "MalwareDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Phish", "PhishingDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Spam" and _action == "blocked", "BlockedBySpamFilter",
            EventResult == "Failure", "Other", ""),
        EmailToRecipients = iff(gettype(_headersTo) == "array", _headersTo, dynamic([])),
        EmailCCRecipients = iff(gettype(_headersCc) == "array", _headersCc, dynamic([])),
        EmailSizeBytes = tolong(column_ifexists("EmailSize", int(null))),
        EmailFileCount = iff(AttachmentCount >= 0, AttachmentCount, int(null)),
        EmailUrlCount = iff(UrlCount >= 0, UrlCount, int(null)),
        SrcUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUserId), "AADID", ""),
        EmailSpfOriginalResult = tostring(_auth.SPF),
        EmailDkimOriginalResult = tostring(_auth.DKIM),
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult = tostring(_auth.DMARC)
    | extend
        Src = SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Rule = RuleName,
        EmailSizeBytes = iff(EmailSizeBytes >= 0, EmailSizeBytes, long(null)),
        EmailSpfResult = tostring(dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","softfail":"SoftFail",
            "neutral":"Neutral","none":"None","temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"})[tolower(EmailSpfOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDkimResult = tostring(dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None",
            "temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"})[tolower(EmailDkimOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDmarcResult = tostring(dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None",
            "bestguesspass":"BestGuessPass"})[tolower(EmailDmarcOriginalResult)]),
        AdditionalFields = bag_remove_keys(_unmapped, dynamic([
            "TimeGenerated","Type","SenderFromAddress","SenderFromDomain","SenderMailFromAddress",
            "SenderMailFromDomain","RecipientEmailAddress","Subject","DeliveryAction","DeliveryLocation",
            "ReportId","EmailActionPolicy","ThreatTypes","ThreatNames","SenderObjectId","SenderIPv4",
            "SenderIPv6","EmailDirection","AuthenticationDetails","To","Cc","EmailSize",
            "AttachmentCount","UrlCount","EmailLanguage"]))
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventType, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventResult, EventResultDetails,
        EventOriginalUid, EventMessage, Dvc, DvcEntityKey, DvcAction, DvcOriginalAction,
        Dst, Src, SrcIpAddr, IpAddr, SrcUserId, SrcUserIdType,
        EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain,
        EmailSubject, EmailLanguage, EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients,
        EmailSizeBytes, EmailFileCount, EmailUrlCount, EmailDirection,
        EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation,
        EmailSpfOriginalResult, EmailSpfResult, EmailDkimOriginalResult, EmailDkimResult,
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult, EmailDmarcResult, RuleName, Rule,
        ThreatOriginalCategory, ThreatName, AdditionalFields, AdditionalEntities
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
